permit-approved: permit (principal, action, resource) when { context.approved == true };
ask-medium-risk: forbid (principal, action, resource) when { context.risk_level == "medium" && context.approved == false };
ask-high-risk: forbid (principal, action, resource) when { context.risk_level == "high" && context.approved == false };
ask-destructive: forbid (principal, action, resource) when { context.destructive == true && context.approved == false };
deny-tainted-egress: forbid (principal, action, resource) when { context.tainted_egress == true };
